# Date Picker

A calendar surface plus two ready pickers, single date and range, over Radix Popover with native Date math and no date dependency. Selection reads the brand accent; the in-range fill stays neutral.

```tsx
const [date, setDate] = React.useState<Date>()

<DatePicker value={date} onChange={setDate} presets clearable />
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli add date-picker
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/date-picker/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import { DatePicker } from "@/components/ui/date-picker"

export function Example() {
  const [date, setDate] = React.useState<Date>()
  return <DatePicker value={date} onChange={setDate} />
}
```

## Calendar

The `Calendar` is the standalone grid the pickers wrap. Use it directly when you need an always-open calendar. The caption cycles day → month → year views; arrow keys move the focused day, PageUp/PageDown move a month, Home/End jump to the week edges.

```tsx
const [date, setDate] = React.useState<Date>(new Date())

<Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate} />
```

## Range selection

Set `mode="range"` to select a `{ from, to }` span. The first click sets the start, the second closes the range; hovering previews the span. Show multiple months with `numberOfMonths`.

```tsx
const [range, setRange] = React.useState<DateRange>()

<Calendar mode="range" selected={range} onSelect={setRange} numberOfMonths={2} />
```

## Presets

Pass `presets` to render a quick-pick rail. Use `presets` (boolean) for the built-in set, or pass your own array. The single-date set ships `getDatePresets()`; the range set ships `getDateRangePresets()` with eleven common spans (Today, Last 7 days, This month, Last year, …).

```tsx
<DateRangePicker presets clearable />
```

```tsx
const presets = getDatePresets().slice(0, 3)

<DatePicker presets={presets} />
```

## Range with presets

The combination most analytics surfaces want: a two-month range picker with the full preset rail.

```tsx
const presets = getDateRangePresets()

<DateRangePicker presets={presets} numberOfMonths={2} />
```

## Sizes

```tsx
<DatePicker size="sm" />
<DatePicker size="md" />
<DatePicker size="lg" />
```

## Constraints

Bound the range with `min` / `max`, or disable arbitrary days with `isDateDisabled`. Disabled days are inert and struck through.

```tsx
<DatePicker
  min={today}
  max={endOfNextMonth}
  isDateDisabled={(d) => d.getDay() === 0 || d.getDay() === 6}
/>
```

## Density

Like the rest of Koala, the calendar honors `density`: `compact` tightens cells and controls for dense application UI.

```tsx
<DatePicker density="compact" presets />
```

## Inside a Field

Drop a picker inside a `Field` and it auto-wires the label, hint, `id`, and error/disabled state, with no manual props.

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>Start date</FieldLabel>
  <DatePicker block placeholder="Select a start date" />
  <FieldHint>Your subscription begins on this date.</FieldHint>
</Field>
```

## FAQ

### When should I reach for the standalone Calendar instead of DatePicker or DateRangePicker?

Use Calendar when you need an always-open grid inline on the page, such as a booking surface or a sidebar. DatePicker and DateRangePicker wrap that same Calendar in a Radix Popover with a trigger, so prefer them whenever the calendar should open from a field-like button.

### How do I switch the range picker to a single-date picker, and how does selection differ?

They are separate exports: DatePicker resolves a single Date, while DateRangePicker resolves a `{ from, to }` DateRange. On the underlying Calendar this maps to `mode="single"` versus `mode="range"`, where the first range click sets `from` and the second closes the span with a hover preview in between.

### What is the difference between passing `presets` as a boolean versus an array?

Passing `presets` as `true` renders the built-in rail: getDatePresets() for DatePicker and getDateRangePresets() for DateRangePicker. Pass your own array of `{ label, value }` items (DatePreset or DateRangePreset) to fully control the shortcuts shown.

### How do I disable specific days like weekends or dates outside a window?

Bound the selectable window with the `min` and `max` props (both inclusive), and pass `isDateDisabled` for arbitrary rules, for example `(d) => d.getDay() === 0 || d.getDay() === 6` to block weekends. Disabled days become inert and render struck through.

### What keyboard navigation does the calendar grid support?

The grid uses a roving tabindex, so arrow keys move the focused day, PageUp and PageDown shift by a month, and Home and End jump to the week edges. Enter or Space commits the focused day, and the caption button cycles the day, month, and year views.

### Do I need to wire up the label and error state when using a picker inside a Field?

No. Both pickers read useFieldContext, so dropping a DatePicker inside a Field auto-wires the `id`, `aria-describedby`, disabled, and error state from the surrounding Field. You can still override explicitly with the `disabled`, `hasError`, and `id` props when used standalone.

## Exports and dependencies

`npx koalaui-cli add date-picker` writes `components/ui/date-picker/`. Import from `@/components/ui/date-picker`:

- Components and helpers: `Calendar`, `DatePicker`, `DateRangePicker`, `getDatePresets`, `getDateRangePresets`, `calendarVariants`, `datePickerTriggerVariants`
- Types: `CalendarProps`, `CalendarSingleProps`, `CalendarRangeProps`, `DatePickerProps`, `DateRangePickerProps`, `DateRange`, `DatePreset`, `DateRangePreset`
- Koala components it installs with it: `animated-label`
- Koala lib helpers it uses: `density`, `field-context`, `tv`, `utils`
- npm packages: `@phosphor-icons/react`, `radix-ui`
